Discounts & Pricing
Corn Storage & Drying Rates
Category
| Rate / Requirement
|
Minimum Storage
| 18¢ (through 12/31/26)
|
Additional Storage
| 4¢ per month (2 cents each 15 days starting 1/1/27 through 8/31/27)
|
Sold Moisture
| 15%
|
Stored Moisture
| 14% (shrink to 14%, drying charge only to 15%)
|
Shrink
| 1.4% per point of moisture (broken on the 1/10)
|
Drying (up to 25%)
| 4¢ per point (broken on the 1/2%)
|
Drying (above 25%)
| 6 1/2¢ per point (broken on the 1/2%)
|
Note: Corn moisture is averaged by the farm. However, any loads over 20% moisture will stand alone and will not be averaged.
Pricing Policy
For grain sold “across the scales,” pricing is determined by the delivery day:
Saturday Delivery: Assigned the Saturday spot price (the day of delivery).
Sunday Delivery: Assigned the following business day’s closing market price .
Soybean Storage & Shrink Rates
Category
| Rate / Requirement
|
Minimum Storage
| 22¢ (through 12/31/26)
|
Additional Storage
| 5¢ per month (2.5 cents each 15 days starting 1/1/27 through 8/31/27)
|
Sold/Stored Moisture
| 13%
|
Shrink (to 15%)
| 2.3% per point of moisture (broken on the 1/2%)
|
Shrink (above 15%)
| 4.0% per point of moisture (broken on the 1/2%)
|
Rejection Limit
| Moisture above 16% is subject to rejection
|
Important Policies
No Averaging: Soybean moisture will not be averaged.
High Moisture Penalty: Any load with moisture greater than 15% will be:
Docked based on the standard discount scale.
Spot sold at the end of the day.
